scenes.note: Quest wakes up. Alarm. Slight camera push.
Quest working at a desk. Emails and paperwork multiply.
Quest receives money. Wallet briefly becomes happy. Same office art, new framing.
Enormous expensive tractor. Tilt-up reveal of scale. Wallet becomes worried, balance drains.
Quest returns home exhausted... and immediately transforms into farmer mode. He just finished working, to start working again.
Split screen OFFICE WORK vs FARM WORK, identical physical rhythm. The Grind wheel spins between them.
There are no dragons — dragon rises dramatically, is instantly rejected.
No princess to save — knight fantasy, rejected. Let the stamp breathe.
Most of the time, your greatest enemy... — mock-epic hero shot, Fear peeks in, lightning.
...is a field that's slightly larger than you expected. Dramatic pull-out: Quest + tractor become tiny. Hold for the punchline.
And yet millions of people voluntarily spend their evenings... — windows light up across the city.

planting crops, transporting fertilizer, feeding animals... — ONE farm illustration, three shots: the camera whips station to station, XP bar fills, then pulls out to reveal all three Quests bouncing in the same grind rhythm.
...and getting genuinely excited about buying a bigger tractor. Bigger tractor drops from the sky. Wallet faints (callback).
Quiet sunset. 'So... why?' SecondQuest identity beat 3.8 s (from "So..."), wordmark readable >= 2.4 s.
